Lina (PM): Need to finalize GA acceptance items for Ship GA by EOD Fri: SLAs, fallback behavior, burst billing guardrail, and docs impact matrix. Quick status?

Evan (Eng): SLA: 99.9% uptime per-route for standard. Latency bands: light <500ms, medium 500-1500ms, heavy >1500ms (heavy marked).

Gia (SRE): Runbooks: trace retention 7d GA, alert if fallback_ratio >5% for 10m -> page SRE + open incident.

Marco (FinOps): Pricing guardrail: committed + capped burst. Example I'll add: 4 reserved GPUs bursting to 40 for 1h => cap 10x baseline_hour. Will post tokenized calc.

Tess (Support): Support: business-hours for self-serve, 24/7 for enterprise. I'll draft impact matrix mapping tiers -> expected behavior and support template for fallback notices.

Evan (Eng): Fallback plan: soft fallback to quantized same-family variant (q4f16), hard fallback to smaller model if needed. We'll add feature flag per-tenant and metric fallback_reason. Est: 5 dev-days.

Lina (PM): Docs requirement: short banner wording + FAQ + impact matrix mapping tiers to fallback & billing caps. Cannot GA without it. docs-bot create stubs.

docs-bot: created -> ./docs/ga/ship-v1/impact-matrix.md (stub)

Marco (FinOps): Posting numeric examples tonight.

Gia (SRE): Adding alerts to staging and runbook steps.

Evan (Eng): Opening flag/metrics PR now (WIP).

Lina (PM): Reconvene 09:00 PST tomorrow to lock wording. If no blockers, GA checklist locked. :white_check_mark:
